parts:
Hi Ray,

程式碼是正確可執行, 繪圖結果顯示以科學符號表示, 如果須以數值表示, 可設定 options(scipen=999), 執行完成後再設定回初值 options(scipen=0), 另可使用 aggregate 計算群組統計資料.

#####
webs <- data.frame(Protocol=gl(5,4,label=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2")),                 Time=c(60000,70000,80000,80000,100000,100000,100000,250000,20,30,40,10,5000,5000,10000,10000,50000,60000,70000,70000))
# method 1
Time = with(webs,
            c( sum(Time[which(Protocol=="UDP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="TCP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="ARP")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="DNS")]),
               sum(Time[which(Protocol=="TLSv1.2")])))
barplot(Time, names.arg=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2"), density=rep(20,5),
        main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")
# method 2
options(scipen=999)
webs.agg <- aggregate(webs$Time, list(Protocol=webs$Protocol), sum) # 290000=2.9E+05
barplot(webs.agg$x, names.arg=webs.agg$Protocol, density=rep(20,5),
        main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")
options(scipen=0) # default
##### end

 main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time"
 )

messages.author: d42e88b7645d03c8
messages.subject: Re: 長條圖Y軸顯示問題
parts:
Hi Ray,

可使用 order 函數, 完整R code:

#####
webs <- data.frame(Protocol=gl(5,4,label=c("UDP","TCP","ARP","DNS","TLSv1.2")), Time=c(60000,70000,80000,80000,100000,100000,100000,250000,20,30,40,10,5000,5000,10000,10000,50000,60000,70000,70000))
webs.agg <- aggregate(webs$Time, list(Protocol=webs$Protocol), sum) # 290000=2.9E+05
webs.agg <- webs.agg[order(webs.agg$x, decreasing=TRUE),]
barplot(webs.agg$x, names.arg=webs.agg$Protocol, density=rep(20,5), main="Protocol",xlab="Protocol",ylab="Time")

##### end
